test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

I wanted to ______ things that girls weren't supposed to do.
solution:
The correct answer is "**do a lot of**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**- The verb "wanted" is in the past tense, so we need a past tense verb form to complete the sentence.

- The phrase "things that girls weren't supposed to do" suggests that the speaker is breaking gender norms or expectations.

- The correct form of the verb "do" in this sentence is "do a lot of", which means to do many things of a particular type.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

- Option 1, "do allot of", is incorrect because "allot" means to distribute or assign, not to do.

- Option 2, "done a lot of", is incorrect because it is the past participle form of the verb "do", not the simple past tense form needed in this sentence.

- Option 3, "do a lot off", is incorrect because "off" is not needed after "a lot of".

- Option 5, "no correction required", is incorrect because there is an error in the sentence that needs to be corrected.

Note: No additional information is needed for this question as it is not a vocab-based question.
